content.title: 2026 NFL Draft in Pittsburgh | Pittsburgh Steelers
content.text: PITTSBURGH IS ON THE CLOCK The 2026 NFL Draft presented by Bud Light is coming to the Steel City on April 23-25, 2026! The three-day event will be split across the Allegheny River with the Draft Theater and Main Stage located on the North Shore, utilizing the area outside Acrisure Stadium as a natural amphitheater. The NFL Draft Experience (the free fan festival) will be centered across the river at Point State Park in Downtown Pittsburgh. View the recently released renderings of the NFL Draft Campus. Entry is FREE and we are excited to welcome all fans across the league to Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania and to showcase the rich football history our city holds. For more information pertaining to the 2026 NFL Draft in Pittsburgh, fans are encouraged to go to Visit Pittsburgh for more details! LOOKING TO ATTEND THE NFL DRAFT? STEELERS COUNTRY ENTERTAINMENT SERIES Kane Brown, Wiz Khalifa & Bret Michaels will headline the NFL Draft Entertainment series April 24th & 25th! NOW SHOWING: 'THE FOOTBALL TOWN' As part of the celebration of Western Pennsylvania's rich football history during the Draft, NFL Films – in partnership with the Pittsburgh Steelers, VisitPITTSBURGH and U. S. Steel – presents The Football Town, at the Kamin Science Center, which explores the region's storied football tradition. There will be FREE showtimes April 23rd-25th! STEELERS PRO SHOP Be Sure To Stop By The Official Steelers Pro Shop For Exclusive Apparel, Hats, & Fan Gear During Your Stay! TASTE OF THE DRAFT TOPPS COLLECTOR CELEBRATION DAY
